title: Why a famous Montreal sandwich shop has been forced to swap its soda
summary: Schwartz's, a Montreal institution known for its smoked meat sandwiches, has switched suppliers for its signature black cherry soda. The change marks an adjustment to a key component of the deli's identity and long-standing customer experience.
content: Schwartz’s, one of Montreal’s most famous delis, has changed suppliers for its black cherry soda.

zh.title: 蒙特利尔著名三明治店为何被迫更换其招牌汽水
zh.summary: 蒙特利尔老字号施瓦茨熟肉三明治店已更换了其招牌樱桃汽水的供应商。这一改变标志着这家熟食店标志性身份和长期客户体验的重要组成部分的调整。
